units.source_text: 人世間合法的東西反而更可怕（它們都讓人預感到高深莫測的東西），

en.t: In the human world, lawful things are actually more frightening, because they all make one sense something unfathomable,

units.source_text: 構造複雜費解，我根本無法坐進那沒有窗戶的陰冷房間，

en.t: its structure was so complicated and incomprehensible that I simply could not sit inside that cold, windowless room,

units.source_text: 即使外面有一片非法的大海，我也要縱身跳進去，

en.t: even if there were an illegal sea outside, I would throw myself into it,

units.source_text: 暢遊到死亡，對我來說，更輕鬆痛快。

en.t: and swimming freely until death seemed easier and more satisfying to me.

units.source_text: 有句話叫「沒臉見人的人」，指的好像是人世間悲慘的失敗者、道德敗壞者，

en.t: There is an expression, “a person who cannot show his face,” and it seems to refer to the wretched failures and morally corrupt people of the world,

units.source_text: 我覺得自己從一出生就是「沒臉見人的人」，

en.t: but I felt that I myself had been such a person from the moment I was born,

units.source_text: 所以每每遇到被世間公認為是「沒臉見人的人」，

en.t: so whenever I met someone whom society openly recognized as one of those people,

units.source_text: 我的心就會變得非常和善，

en.t: my heart would always grow very gentle,

units.source_text: 這樣的「善心」有時連自己都會陶醉。

en.t: and sometimes I would even become intoxicated by that “kindness” myself.
